discoveries.choice: The file holds exactly one line of prose rather than multiple notes.
discoveries.whyItMatters: A single-line notes.txt means there is only one piece of content to validate or diff; any plan assuming a list of independent notes has nothing to enumerate.

alternatives.option: Write several distinct lines of notes
alternatives.consequence: The file would exercise multi-line handling and give reviewers more than one behavior to confirm or correct.
No behavioral content would exist at all, making review vacuous.

recommendation.reason: It is the observable content and any analysis must be scoped to a single line.

discoveries.choice: The line uses the lowercase plural noun 'notes' with no trailing period or punctuation.
discoveries.whyItMatters: Stylistic casing/punctuation is a formatting convention that affects whether downstream tooling that normalizes or parses text behaves predictably.

alternatives.option: Sentence-case with a terminating period, e.g. 'One line of notes.'
alternatives.consequence: Would impose prose conventions on what may be a data/notes file, potentially conflicting with existing conventions.
Would make case-insensitive matching necessary and look inconsistent with typical notes files.

recommendation.reason: The file reads as informal free-text notes, so no punctuation convention is required.

discoveries.choice: The content self-describes its own form ('one line of notes') rather than documenting a subject.
discoveries.whyItMatters: The line conveys no domain information; any plan expecting notes.txt to carry substantive requirements would find nothing to act on.

alternatives.option: Write notes about the actual subject matter of the phase
alternatives.consequence: Would give reviewers real behavior to verify but would require inventing content not present in the repo.
Would signal intentionally incomplete work rather than a self-referential description.

recommendation.choice: Treat the line as self-descriptive placeholder content
recommendation.reason: That is literally what the file says, and no other content exists to interpret.
